official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) If you control any "Contractor Artemis", you can send the 20px from this Spirit/your Trash to your Life.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Moonlight Seal] or [Moonlight Seal: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Moonlight Seal]", "give [Moonlight Seal]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
